sloka: आचार्या गुरवो वृद्धा वृथा वाम् पर्युपासिताः ।सारम् यद् राज शास्त्राणाम् अनुजीव्यम् न गृह्यते ॥६-२९-९॥।।
transliteration: ācāryā guravo vṛddhā vṛthā vām paryupāsitāḥ ।sāram yad rāja śāstrāṇām anujīvyam na gṛhyate ॥6-29-9॥।।

translations.english: "You have not grasped that which is the essence of political wisdom in the sastras in spite of waiting upon elders, teachers and parents which was in vain."
